documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings where management highlighted challenges from global supply disruptions, elevated raw materials, and monsoon uncertainties, which later showed recovery. Despite these external pressures, the company registered a 35% year-on-year growth in operating revenue to ₹ 532 crore and a 36% increase in EBITDA to ₹ 89 crore. Management noted that raw material availability has now smoothened, and capacity utilization of the newly expanded NPK-DAP and SSP units is expected to ramp up in subsequent quarters. Furthermore, the company introduced new complex fertilizer variants to improve product mix and support sustainable growth. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational results, highlighting a 34.58% year-on-year increase in quarterly revenue to Rs 532.3 crore and a 53.88% growth in Profit After Tax to Rs 47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line revenue growth of around 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates delivering growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, triggering a rapid acceleration in Kharif growing across the primary marketing zone.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July. This pivot has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif growing across our primary marketing zone.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly lower monsoon forecast because reservoir and water levels are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and imports would absorb any hypothetical softening.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company added another 165,000 metric tonnes of capacity, taking total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 metric tonnes.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The green ammonia capacity from a third-party agreement will start in FY29 after 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that expanded capacities at Meghnagar, specifically NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity to 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly completed capacity expansion has commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
capex_expansion.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to Rs 47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global market input prices witnessed firming trends from mid-February onwards, driven by supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor to maintaining EBITDA margins higher than peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: For the quarter, • Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: • 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: For the quarter, fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT driven by peak Rabi demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value from ₹ 10 to ₹ 2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that Krishana's strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars, including disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not planned any additional capex beyond what has already been implemented.
capital_allocation.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delays in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed in March while input costs were increasing, creating cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates, exposing the cost structure to global movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia facility capacity under the agreement with SECI will start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the benefits of the recent capacity expansion to meaningfully reflect in its performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
